ali.title: Tour May 14
ali.details:
**Tourist Attractions**  
- Colosseum, Roman Forum, Palatine Hill (Rome)  
- Pyramids of Giza, Sphinx, Egyptian Museum (Cairo)  
- Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace (Istanbul)  

**Cheap Hotels**  
- Hotel Artemide (Rome) – €50–70/night  
- Nile View Guest House (Cairo) – €30–45/night  
- Sultanahmet Guesthouse (Istanbul) – €35–55/night  

**Premium Hotels**  
- Hotel De Russie (Rome) – €200–300/night  
- Sofitel Cairo Nile El Gezirah (Cairo) – €180–250/night  
- Çırağan Palace Kempinski (Istanbul) – €250–350/night  

**Estimated Cost**  
- Daily budget per person: €80–120 (incl. food, local transport, entrance fees)  
- 3‑day trip for 3 people: €720–1,080 total (excluding flights)  

**Food Recommendations**  
- Street‑food pizza al taglio (Rome)  
- Koshari stalls (Cairo)  
- Balık ekmek (fish sandwich) by the Golden Horn (Istanbul)  

**Packing Suggestions**  
- Warm layers, thermal base, wool coat, hat & gloves  
- Waterproof jacket & sturdy boots for cobblestones  
- Compact travel umbrella, reusable water bottle  

**Usual Weather**  
- Cold: average 8–12 °C (Rome, Istanbul)  
- Cairo: mild 12–15 °C, cooler nights  

**Travel Tips**  
- Buy city‑pass for free entry to major sites  
- Learn basic greetings in Italian, Arabic, Turkish  
- Check visa requirements ahead of time  
- Keep cash in small denominations for street vendors  
- Travel during daylight to avoid cold night walks  

**Your Preference**  
- Historical sites, cold weather, street food  
- 3 people, 19‑year‑old, from India.
